sections.description: Detects WordPress sites in bulk and reports plugin, theme and widget usage. A marketing and research tool for agencies. No premium tier, no upsells, no tracking, GPL licensed.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Improved deep-scan reliability on large sites.
  • Added inner-page detection toggle.
  • Hardened request handling.

1.3.0

  • Widget detection.
sections.installation: Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/, activate, and configure under MBR → Bulk WP Detector.
